import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> idMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int N, counter;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static long[][] dp = new long[2][70003];
    static int[][] trans = new int[70003][128];
    static int[] prob = new int[128];
    static long inv100;

    static long modPow(long base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet x) {
        if (idMap.containsKey(x)) return idMap.get(x);
        int nodeId = ++counter;
        idMap.put(x, nodeId);
        BitSet[] tmp = new BitSet[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            tmp[i] = new BitSet(1 << N);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (x.get(j)) {
                    tmp[i].set(j | (1 << i));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            BitSet temp = (BitSet) x.clone();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    temp.or(tmp[j]);
                }
            }
            trans[nodeId][mask] = dfs(temp);
        }
        return nodeId;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        BitSet initial = new BitSet(1 << N);
        initial.set(0);
        dfs(initial);
        inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        System.err.println(idMap.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
            }
        }

        dp[0][1] = 1;
        int current = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                prob[j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    int p = ((j >> k) & 1) == 1 ? P[i][k] : 100 - P[i][k];
                    prob[j] = (int)((long)prob[j] * inv100 % MOD * p % MOD);
                }
            }
            Arrays.fill(dp[current ^ 1], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= counter; j++) {
                if (dp[current][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); k++) {
                        int t = trans[j][k];
                        dp[current ^ 1][t] = (dp[current ^ 1][t] + dp[current][j] * prob[k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            current ^= 1;
        }
        BitSet finalMask = new BitSet(1 << N);
        finalMask.set(0, 1 << N);
        int answer = dp[current][idMap.get(finalMask)];
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
